about: Every place the mod touches Risk of Rain 2 (RoR2.dll, 2026-10 build, decompiled with ilspycmd for reference only). method = 'event' subscribes to a public RoR2 event, 'harmony-prefix'/'harmony-postfix' patch with HarmonyX (shipped with BepInEx 5), 'component' = our own MonoBehaviour on our own objects. No R2API: content is registered through RoR2's own ContentManager provider API so nothing extra has to be installed or bundled. reads = which sheet columns drive it.

rows.purpose: register body prefabs, survivor defs, skill defs/families, entity state types and buff defs (one IContentPackProvider; loads the Deadlock cache during the loading screen)
answer DLR_* tokens (names, subtitles, lore, skill names/descriptions, buff names) in every language
apply our buffs' move speed / attack speed / armor / regen and slow resistance (vanilla level scaling of base stats is untouched and comes from the level* fields)
Fixation and Napalm damage amp from their owner, Bullet Dance evasion

rows.target: DeadlockOfRain.ModelBuilder.Build (a model GameObject built per hero from the cache)
rows.purpose: skeleton + one SkinnedMeshRenderer per material + legacy Animation clips from the player's Deadlock install, attached to the body's ModelLocator with CharacterModel/HurtBoxGroup/ChildLocator

pick idle/run/sprint/jump/land clips from CharacterMotor + InputBank each frame, layer gestures (reload/abilities) on the upper body; gun rig: hold the gun arms in aimPose, weld the gun to its hand, turn the chest so the gun points at the camera aim, recoil on shots
play the hero's Deadlock sounds (decoded WAVs in the cache) at volume_master * volume_sfx, with distance falloff from the camera

Melty test.checks: while %LOCALAPPDATA%/Melty/test/deadlock-of-rain.json exists, start a run, play each hero, measure every skill's effect against skills.expect, check the gun rig, the 4 skill slots plus the starting ult equipment, level stats and scale, and append pass/fail lines to the checks file

rows.target: RoR2.UI.LoadoutPanelController+Row.FromSkin (public static on a private nested class)
rows.purpose: give our heroes' empty skins row one 'Default' button, so the loadout panel's gamepad navigation does not index an empty row
shorten timed debuffs on a hero with debuffResist (Abrams' Infernal Resilience)
a hero with damageHealBack heals back that fraction of each hit taken over damageHealBackTime (Infernal Resilience)

rows.target: DeadlockOfRain.Buffs.Stack (called from our guns and projectiles)
rows.purpose: add stacking debuffs (crits add critStacks) and fire their trigger at triggerStacks: Fixation burst, Static discharge, Afterburn ignition

rows.target: RoR2's SiphonNearbyBodyAttachment (Mired Urn) spawned on Abrams for Siphon Life
rows.purpose: tether up to chainCount enemies within radius, drain damagePct per second, heal Abrams for the damage
give allies inside Seven's storm the vanilla Warbanner buff (+30% attack and move speed)
Concussive Combustion: each kill by the blast heals Infernus healFraction of his max health
register one EquipmentDef per equipment row (cooldown, drop rules, icon, a small hero figure as the pickup model); RoR2 puts canDrop equipment into the chest pools itself

answer true for our equipment so RoR2 spends the charge and starts the 120 s cooldown; starts the ult state at once when this side has authority over the body (the host's own body, AI bodies, Bottled Chaos)
on a remote client that owns the body, start the ult state there (states run where the body has authority)
a Deadlock hero's first body of the run gets their own ult equipment (once per player; swap it away and it stays gone)
pulse a fire blast around the body every interval for duration, adding Afterburn build-up
